request.system: Assess whether the hypothesis or expression uses or tests numbered claims. Return JSON only: {"uses_claim": true|false, "claim_ids": []}.
request.prompt: {"claims": {"1": "**Migration report**", "2": "Across four submissions, none produced a usable signal.", "3": "The first interaction, pairing momentum in one flow rate with wage-level momentum, had essentially zero rank correlation (about 0.00, t near 0.1), in both low and high T states.", "4": "It also had thin coverage, about half.", "5": "The second was invalid because I used a non-whitelisted transformation, which wasted a slot.", "6": "Restricting hours momentum to the high-T regime gave a tiny positive correlation (0.01), with no reliable t-statistic.", "7": "An hours-versus-wage spread in the high-T regime was slightly negative (-0.02, t -0.4).", "8": "Regime-gated features were highly persistent (0.45-0.50 autocorrelation).", "9": "Next I would try other variables and lower-persistence constructions."}, "hypothesis": "Groups with larger 3-month increases in the V04 flow rate, ranked cross-sectionally and applied only in low-T regimes, have lower next-month returns than groups with smaller increases, so the rank correlation is negative.", "expression": "regime(csrank(chg(V04,3)),\"low\")"}
